parallel.requirements: Recognized the required Python argparse and bech32.decode behavior, including HRP, SegWit address parsing, exact stdout, and /output/test5.mjs delivery.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Chose a workflow plan: six parallel black-box probe children, then a global spec, two candidate implementations, scoring, hardening, critics, and promotion.
parallel.implementation: The parent wrote a scratch reference and harness, but the workflow never reached its implementation stage; no final Node files were promoted into /output.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Delivery failed: artifact validation found an empty output directory with no expected test5.mjs entry point.
parallel.verification: Several child probes produced substantial empirical results, but no integrated candidate or final verification result was delivered before timeout.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run was killed with checksum-core retry still in progress; official evaluation completed against an empty artifact and passed 0 of 70 samples.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same migration requirements and empirically mapped argparse, bech32 checksum, HRP length, character, version, length, and formatting behavior.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Kept ownership in one serial agent: probe the executable, write a modular ESM implementation, run differential suites, fix discovered mismatches, and deliver.
serial.implementation: Created /output/test5.mjs and lib modules for charset, checksum, convertbits, bech32, segwit, Python repr formatting, argparse, and exports.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Delivered the expected entry point plus library files; artifact validation copied those files successfully.
serial.verification: Ran deterministic corpus checks, fuzz comparisons, and CLI edge cases, then fixed the bare -- separator mismatch and re-ran suites.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Despite local verification and a complete artifact, the official evaluator marked solution_passed false with 58 of 70 samples passed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel identified the Python source and bech32/argparse migration obligations but did not deliver code satisfying the prompt.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial identified the same requirements and explicitly reported the behavior classes it implemented.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Requirement understanding was similar; the difference was that serial carried requirements into an artifact while parallel stopped before delivery.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into six probe children and downstream spec, implementation, scoring, hardening, and critic stages.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial retained one owner for probing, implementation, verification, and final delivery with workflow tools disabled.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel ownership existed but depended on all probe children clearing; serial avoided a child-barrier dependency.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs carried detailed requirements, including exact constants and output behavior, so the issue was not missing context.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept context in one trajectory and final notes reflected the discovered behavior and verification assumptions.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No context-loss contrast was established; the concrete difference was scope and barrier management.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel planned candidate implementations only after spec synthesis, and that stage was never reached.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote the modular implementation and entry point directly in /output.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial produced code; parallel left implementation incomplete and unpromoted.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow waited for all probe results; checksum-core stalled, was retried, and remained in progress when killed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial consumed its local findings and moved through implementation, verification, a fix, and final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel results did not complete the lifecycle into spec and implementation; serial findings stayed actionable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel never promoted a final implementation into /output, so artifact validation found no files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial delivered the expected entry file and support modules in the artifact.
comparison_dimensions.difference: This is the largest material delivery difference: empty artifact versus complete file tree.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child probes generated evidence but no integrated candidate reached final verification or acceptance.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial reported deterministic, fuzz, and argparse edge-case verification before closure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had pre-submission acceptance evidence for a delivered artifact; parallel had probe evidence without integrated acceptance.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the full cell budget, returned code 143, and closed with process_ok false.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed with return code 0 and remaining provider budget, then official evaluation scored 58/70.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel budget was exhausted before delivery; serial closed normally but still had ordinary evaluator failures.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is both_fail, not a discordant pass/fail split: current completed status evaluation reports parallel 0/70 and serial 58/70, with solution_passed false for both. The concrete task-solving gap is nevertheless large because the parallel run timed out with an empty artifact, while the serial run delivered a tested implementation artifact that earned partial credit.
parallel_contributors: Workflow barrier after six probe children prevented implementation while one oversized checksum-core probe stalled and retried.
The final artifact directory was empty, so official evaluation had no entry point to test.
serial_contributors: Serial kept end-to-end ownership and produced /output/test5.mjs plus library modules.
Serial ran differential suites and fixed a discovered bare -- CLI parsing mismatch before final response.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial still missed 12 of 70 official samples despite local verification, an ordinary implementation/evaluator mismatch not mapped to a parallel concurrency label.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: No outcome difference; retained pattern explains adverse parallel delivery and score gap, not a discordant pass/fail outcome.

The workflow state shows that checksum-core stalled, was retried, and remained in progress when the workflow was killed. The serial run explored the same behavior locally, wrote the implementation, and delivered files, so the adverse parallel consequence is empty delivery rather than a pass/fail difference.
